home.title: Metra

owner.label: Owner
owner.desc: Full access, including firm margin and settings. Signs contracts.

admin.label: Admin
admin.desc: Manages projects, people and settings; can approve and issue.

project_manager.label: Project Manager
project_manager.desc: Builds proposals, schedules work, records costs and drafts invoices.

site_engineer.label: Site Engineer
site_engineer.desc: Phone-first: updates progress and logs costs and custody spend.

accountant.label: Accountant
accountant.desc: Costs, custody, invoices, payments and exports.

client.label: Client
client.desc: Portal access: views progress and approves proposals and variations.
